record.paper: Towards Characterization of 5-List-Colorability of Toroidal Graphs

dossier_meta.paper: Towards Characterization of 5-List-Colorability of Toroidal Graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Every graph drawn on the torus with edge-width at least four is 5-choosable.
dossier_meta.context_text: This is proposed as an important intermediate step towards Conjecture 3, focusing on toroidal graphs with no non-contractible cycle of length less than four. Postle proved that the edge-width of a graph critical for 5-list coloring is at most logarithmic in its genus, so the conjecture holds when four is replaced by a sufficiently large constant.
